strings.name: Elton John
strings.summary: Born Reginald Dwight, John studied at the Royal Academy of Music as a boy and later formed a lasting partnership with lyricist Bernie Taupin. Piano-driven pop-rock, stage performances and songs for musicals and films brought broad audiences. Through his foundation he supports HIV/AIDS prevention and anti-discrimination advocacy. After ending his farewell tour in 2023, he continued recording and collaborating rather than leaving musical creation.
